title: Transport What Shares the Conduction Pathway: Normal-Anchored SPD Geometric Transport for Source-Free Patient Adaptation of Holter and Patch ECG
abstract: arXiv:2610.24430v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Continuous electrocardiogram (ECG) streams are dominated by normal beats (87.9-98.6% of the label-free adaptation prefix in our four databases), and patient-specific waveform distortion is not shared by every beat class; under this combination, source-free and test-time adaptation methods that assume class-balanced target batches collapse. We propose Normal-Anchored Geometric Transport (NAGT, GA_NS), which estimates a closed-form symmetric positive-definite congruence map from label-free normal anchors in the first 5 min of each recording and applies it only to the normal and supraventricular prototypes, keeping the ventricular and fusion prototypes fixed. Decision rules were set on MIT-BIH and the rate-invariant RR head was adopted after the development databases (INCART, SVDB) had been opened; the frozen model was then evaluated once under a pre-specified locked evaluation protocol on the held-out Icentia11k chest-patch cohort. translated_title: 迁移共享传导通路的成分：面向Holter与贴片心电无源患者自适应的正常心跳锚定SPD几何传输
translated_abstract: 连续心电图（ECG）数据流以正常心跳为主导（在我们四个数据库中，正常心跳占无标签自适应前缀段的87.9%–98.6%），而患者特异性的波形畸变并非每个心跳类别都会共享；在这种组合情形下，那些假设目标批次类别均衡的无源自适应与测试时自适应方法将会失效。我们提出正常心跳锚定几何传输（Normal-Anchored Geometric Transport，NAGT，GA_NS），该方法从每条记录前5分钟内的无标签正常心跳锚点估计出一个闭式解的对称正定（SPD）合同变换映射，并仅将其施加于正常心跳与室上性心跳的原型，同时保持室性及融合波原型不变。决策规则在MIT-BIH上设定，并在开发数据库（INCART、SVDB）开启后采用了心率不变的RR间期头；随后，冻结的模型在预留的Icentia11k胸贴队列上，按照预先指定的锁定评估协议仅评估一次。（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出正常心跳锚定几何传输（NAGT），仅从每条记录前5分钟的无标签正常心跳估计闭式对称正定变换，并只将其作用于共享传导通路的正常与室上性原型，从而在正常心跳占绝对主导、患者特异性畸变不跨类共享的真实ECG流上实现稳健的无源患者自适应。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes Normal-Anchored Geometric Transport (NAGT), which estimates a closed-form symmetric positive-definite congruence map from label-free normal beats in the first 5 minutes and transports only the normal and supraventricular prototypes, enabling robust source-free patient adaptation on realistic ECG streams where normal beats dominate and patient-specific distortion is not shared across beat classes.
